summary: Corrected the pending-read-index investigation's disposition to explained so it matches its recorded refuting interpretation, then reselected onto the recovery/resynchronization axis: traced who can repair a follower left in tracker.StateSnapshot. maybeSendSnapshot enters that state (gated on RecentActive), IsPaused is unconditionally true there so appends and heartbeat-driven appends are no-ops, and exactly two producers exit it - a peer MsgAppResp that strictly advances pr.Match and satisfies pr.Match+1 >= firstIndex (BecomeProbe/BecomeReplicate), or an application ReportSnapshot delivered as MsgSnapStatus. Recorded that as a behavior and an explained source account with no defect claim, explicitly noting the responsibility boundary (a lost MsgAppResp needs the documented application report; an ignored obsolete snapshot can reply at or below pr.Match and not repair) and the source-only/no-receipt limitations.
